note: Structured mirror of /INDUSTRIES.md (which declares itself the canonical registry for industry counts). This JSON exists so agents, CI lints, and frontend code can consume the registry without parsing markdown. If /INDUSTRIES.md and this file disagree, /INDUSTRIES.md wins. Mirror this file to landing-pages/dws10-com/config/industries.json in the same commit (CLAUDE.md dual-folder sync rule).

summary.framework: The platform serves 25 distinct EU regulated industries (per /INDUSTRIES.md). The captain fundraising framework clusters 20 of them into 16 captain hats — some hats cover a single vertical, others combine related verticals with shared regulatory exposure. The remaining 5 industries (Manufacturing cross-sector, Healthcare, Financial Services, Public Sector, Data Centres) are platform customers without a dedicated captain hat — they ride on platform purchase rather than the captain SAFE-tranche structure.
summary.aegisProductIndustryCountNote: DWS IQ Aegis (defence/dual-use tier) covers 21 of the 25 platform industries. Excluded from Aegis scope: Healthcare, Financial Services, Public Sector (some sub-segments), Real Estate — the consumer-facing or financial-services-only verticals. Aegis = 21 is intentional product scope, not drift from the platform-wide 25. Source: Store/PRODUCT_AEGIS.md.

industriesCovered.foldedReason: Hydrogen production and RED III regulation overlap with chemicals process expertise.
Vessel LCA, FuelEU Maritime, ETS Maritime overlap with operating-shipping regulatory stack.
Extends road-transport hat to multimodal freight; ETS2 + CountEmissionsEU shared regulatory base.
EPBD, embodied carbon, building portfolios — same regulatory layer, different buyer (owner vs. builder).

platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.rationale: Cross-cutting — spans Iron & Steel, Chemicals, Aluminium captain hats. No standalone captain seat; served by overlapping hats based on customer's primary sector.
platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.platformOffering: Digital Product Passports, plant-level energy + emissions, ESPR, CSRD

platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.rationale: Distinct compliance posture (EHDS, MDR, ESRS S1). Not in captain framework launch; platform customer.
platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.platformOffering: Facility carbon, ESRS S1, EHDS-aligned secondary data

platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.rationale: Financed-emissions domain (SFDR, EU Taxonomy, CRR3) differs from operational-emissions captain hats. Not in launch captain framework.
platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.platformOffering: Financed-emissions accounting, PAI tables, Taxonomy KPIs

platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.rationale: Procurement-driven (GPP, NIS2) with sovereign on-prem deployment requirements. Not in launch captain framework.
platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.platformOffering: Sovereign on-prem AI, GPP green procurement, NIS2 dossiers

platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.rationale: EED + Data Centre Energy Reporting Delegated Reg distinct from emissions captain hats. Committed May 2026. Not in launch captain framework.
platformIndustriesWithoutDedicatedCaptai.platformOffering: PUE/WUE telemetry, Annex VII reporting, sovereign on-prem AI
